observations.body: The appeal comes from a fellow elder, witness of Christ’s sufferings, and participant in the glory to be revealed.
observations.label: Self-presentation

observations.body: Elders are told to tend the flock willingly, without dishonest gain or domination, and as examples.
observations.label: Shepherding

observations.body: Silvanus is named in connection with the letter, and the closing greeting includes Mark, called the writer’s son.
observations.label: Closing relationships

payload.posture: Read the appeal, shepherding contrasts, promise, exhortations, and named relationships as one closing movement.
payload.tension: The writer joins authority to shared eldership and witness while directing leaders away from compulsion, gain, and domination.
payload.title: Fellow elder, witness, and shepherd
